text:
Ravi: Odd bug report: our ESM edge sample drops Authorization header only after bundling -> causes SDK to retry. CJS bundle fine. Repro attached.
Lena: can you paste tsconfig + bundler flags?
Ravi: tsconfig: module=ESNext, target=ES2022, preserveValueImports=false, moduleResolution=node, esModuleInterop=true. Bundler: esbuild, minify=true, platform=browser.
Ravi: sample call: `client.call('/v1/echo', { auth: token, headers: { 'x-env': 'demo' } })` -> dev (ts-node) ok; built esm bundle: `Authorization` shows as undefined -> 401 -> sdk retries.
Omar: my hunch: type-only overloads or generics caused the emitted helper to change shape. if the implementation signature isn't runtime-visible, some bundlers collapse the forwarding wrapper. I've seen `unknown` vs `any` influence emitted guards too.
Lena: do you have emitted JS around the request helper?
Ravi: yes — ESM build shows `export function req(u,o){o=o||{};const h=o.headers||{};/* o.auth missing here */}` whereas CJS has explicit `h.Authorization = o.auth?.token`.
Omar: that points to TS erasing a value-level param because it only existed in an overload. Workarounds: avoid type-only overloads for exported wrappers; add an explicit `options: Record<string, any>` runtime param; or set `preserveValueImports=true`.
Lena: also try `moduleResolution: bundler` for esbuild compatibility. and toggle `esbuild` minify off - minify sometimes lets the tree-shaker drop very small forwarding helpers.
Ravi: changed to preserveValueImports=true + minify=false -> ESM bundle preserves auth, tests green.
DocsBot: NOTE: added short onboarding blurb to edge-samples: "If Authorization missing in ESM bundles: check preserveValueImports, moduleResolution, and avoid type-only overloads in runtime wrappers."
Omar: for long-term fix in SDK: export a tiny non-type-only forwarding function so bundlers always see the runtime use. also add a compile-and-emit test that builds minimal TS -> esbuild and asserts `opts.auth` is present in emitted JS.
Lena: typings note: prefer `auth?: { token: string }` in the runtime signature instead of overloads mixing generics and conditional types — reduces chance of erasure. and prefer `unknown` in internal generics but cast to `any` only at the boundary that's intentionally runtime-visible.
Ravi: I'll open a PR to samples + a SDK issue for d.ts shape changes and attach the minimal repro. tagging infra to review the test.
CI-Bot: build: edge-esm-auth-repro #3 failed on node 20 (repro shows missing Authorization) :warning:
Omar: thanks — also worth a short blurb in the SDK changelog about ESM emit compatibility and recommended tsconfig for edge targets.
